thread:
maria_g (Partnerships): heads up — partner ops want a short checklist for the driver/CUDA/ROCm pin we agreed on. they need it for the marketplace image publish tomorrow. :spiral_calendar:
rajiv (Eng): can we lock on exact package names/versions? last-minute mismatches caused the hk regression last month.
sophia_rt (Runtime): propose: CUDA=12.2.1, nvidia-driver=535.86, cuDNN=8.9.1; ROCm=6.5.0, kernel-abi-note v5+. i'll paste a minimal mapping in a sec.
kevin_p (Platform): also call out the fallback policy: if partner image fails staging, route to hosted-compatible image and flag the partner build. we should avoid a marketplace-wide outage.
juan_s (SI Eng): for on-prem SI installs, we need an ops snippet to pin kernel modules and driver packages (some shops auto-upgrade drivers). mention apt/yum hold and rpm --setopt.
sophia_rt (Runtime): mapping snippet:
```
# marketplace pinned matrix
cuda: 12.2.1
nvidia-driver: 535.86
cudnn: 8.9.1
rocm: 6.5.0
kernel-min: 5.15
notes: "rocm builds need dkms for 5.19+ on some distros"
```
maria_g (Partnerships): nice. add the partner comms blurb: "we recommend pinning to this matrix; if you can't, file a compat issue with logs and we'll schedule a hotfix window."
rajiv (Eng): for regressions, add triage steps: collect system-probe, nvml logs, runtime trace. small checklist: 1) reproduce on partner image 2) validate on our hosted image 3) collect /var/log/redwood/runtime.log and nvml dumps. include a sample command.
rajiv (Eng): sample collect commands:
```
sudo journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 500 > /tmp/runtime.log
nvidia-smi -q -x > /tmp/nvidia.xml
/opt/redwood/bin/system-probe --dump-kv > /tmp/kvcache.json
```
kevin_p (Platform): ops actions for a hotfix deploy (high level): 1) pin builder image in marketplace CI 2) trigger partner canary (10%) 3) monitor P95 latency and GPU OOMs for 30m 4) roll forward or rollback. Can we add a single `kubectl` restart snippet for fast mitigation?
sophia_rt (Runtime): yes — mitigation snippet:
```
kubectl -n marketplace rollout restart daemonset/redwood-runtime-gpu
# or patch image temporarily
kubectl -n marketplace set image ds/redwood-runtime-gpu redwood-runtime-gpu=registry.redwood/company-pin:638
```
juan_s (SI Eng): for SI installs, note that some customers run custom kernel flags. add an item: "verify kernel module ABI with /sys/module/nvidia/version and /proc/driver/rocm/version" — that'll catch mismatched builds.
maria_g (Partnerships): i'll draft the partner-facing checklist email and the marketplace docs blurb. quick Q: do we want to call out an SLA for hotfix timing (e.g., 48h triage window)?
rajiv (Eng): 48h triage ack seems fine, but escalations to eng-oncall if high-sev within 2h. add escalation contact.
kevin_p (Platform): i'll add runbook links in the marketplace webhook so partners see them during publish. deploy-bot, can you create a small incident template for "partner-driver-compat"?
deploy-bot: created incident template ID #PT-8842 for partner-driver-compat. Template includes fields: severity, partner, image-tag, reproducible-steps, logs-upload.
maria_g (Partnerships): perfect. i'll circulate the draft to partners and copy eng/SI. thanks all — aim to lock copy by EOD so ops can bake it into CI. :thumbsup:
